name: 倒计时
description: 横屏全屏倒计时模块，支持按小时/分钟/秒设置倒计时时长，自动按分钟秒或时分秒显示，支持剩余1分钟震动三次和最后若干秒每秒震动提醒
description_en: Landscape fullscreen countdown timer with hour/minute/second settings, automatic mm:ss or hh:mm:ss display, one-minute triple vibration, and final per-second vibration alerts.

permissions.name: android.permission.VIBRATE
permissions.desc: 用于倒计时提醒震动，包括剩余1分钟震动三次和最后若干秒每秒震动
permissions.desc_en: Vibrate for countdown alerts, including one-minute triple vibration and final per-second vibration.

apis.name: createCountdown
apis.desc: 创建并启动倒计时，可通过 durationSeconds 或 hours/minutes/seconds 设置时长，支持设置标题、剩余1分钟震动三次、最后若干秒每秒震动。适合用户说“倒计时10分钟”“倒计时1小时30分钟并最后10秒震动”等场景。
apis.desc_en: Create and start a countdown. Set duration by durationSeconds or hours/minutes/seconds, with optional title, triple vibration at one minute remaining, and per-second vibration during the final N seconds.
paramDesc: 总倒计时秒数，可选；优先级高于 hours/minutes/seconds
分钟数，可选，默认页面配置
剩余1分钟时是否震动三次，可选，默认跟随页面默认设置
最后多少秒每秒震动一次，可选，默认跟随页面默认设置；0表示关闭
打开页面后是否立即横屏全屏启动，可选，默认true
paramDesc_en: Total countdown seconds, optional; takes precedence over hours/minutes/seconds
Minutes, optional, default follows page defaults
Whether to vibrate three times at one minute remaining; optional, follows page default
Vibrate once per second during the final N seconds; optional, follows page default; 0 disables
Start in landscape fullscreen after opening the page; optional, default true

apis.name: getDefaultSettings
apis.desc: 获取倒计时页面默认设置，供未明确设置时参考
apis.desc_en: Get default countdown page settings for prompts that omit options.
